shared_elements: band of repeated vertical strokes forming a horizontal register
stacked/registered composition on an irregular stone surface
long-necked, beak-like or snouted head in profile
small subordinate figure beside a larger one
justification: Both surfaces stack motifs in loose horizontal registers and both contain a band of closely repeated vertical strokes (the row of crew-marks in A, the zigzag/tooth band in B) plus profile creatures with elongated snouted or beaked heads. But the manner of execution is fundamentally different — A is a flat linear silhouette in red pigment on a rough natural rock face, B is carefully modelled low relief on a dressed rectangular pillar — and the specific subjects (a manned boat and a striding human with a hafted object versus rows of quadrupeds and birds) do not correspond.
